title: Playbook
description: Declarative incident-response playbook: trigger conditions + an ordered list of steps executed against a matching investigation (Wave 3, Phase K).

id.description: Stable unique identifier for this playbook, e.g. 'ransomware-response-v1'.

trigger.description: Conditions under which this playbook fires for an incoming alert.

severity.description: Alert severities (case-insensitive) that this playbook applies to.

tags.description: Tags/classification keywords/MITRE technique IDs matched against the alert's classification, tactic, technique, and description fields.

steps.description: Ordered list of steps executed in sequence when this playbook's trigger matches.

params.description: Free-form parameters passed to the step's handler.

on_failure.description: abort: stop the whole playbook. continue: log the failure and proceed. retry: retry the step once, then fall back to 'continue' semantics.

timeout_seconds.description: Advisory timeout for this step (not currently enforced by a hard deadline, recorded for audit/future use).
